title.en: Requiring All Locators Under the Act of Congress Of July 1, 1902, as Amended, to Secure Mining Lease Contracts Under the Provisions of Presidential Decree No. 463 Involving Their Patentable Mining Claims

text.en:
Holders of subsisting and valid patentable mining claims, lode or placer, located under the
provisions of the Act of Congress of July 1, 1902, as amended, shall file a mining lease application therefor
with the Mines Regional office concerned within a period of one (1) year from the approval of this Decree,
and upon the filling thereof, holders of the said claims shall be considered to have waived their rights to the
issuance of mining patents therefor: Provided, however, That the non-filing of the application for mining lease
by the holders thereof within the period herein prescribed shall cause the forfeiture of all his rights to the

No mines temporary permit shall be required of a holder of a patentable mining claim, lode or
placer, in the extraction and disposal of minerals taken therefrom prior to the filling of the mining lease
application therefor; Provided, That upon the filling of the said application, the provisions of Presidential
Decree No. 463 shall apply: Provided, further, That patent applications already published shall be exempted
from the publication requirements of Presidential Decree No. 463.

If any section or provision of this Decree is held or declared unconstitutional or invalid by a
competent court, the other sections or provisions hereof shall continue to be in force as if the sections or
provisions so annulled or voided had never been incorporated in this Decree.

All laws, decrees, rules and regulations or parts thereof in conflict or inconsistent with any of the
provisions of this Decree are hereby repealed or modified accordingly.

This Decree shall take effect immediately.
DONE in the City of Manila, this 14th day of October, in the year of Our Lord, nineteen hundred and

seventy-seven.
